summary: Added the 'nerve' kind platform-wide and surfaced it as the Systems row's 'Cranial nerves' toggle. CHANGED (in scope): src/types.ts (Kind union += 'nerve' with a coverage-proof doc block; StructureRecord += optional modality?/course? per PLAN.md §4.2, which the 12 nerve records use); src/data/load.ts (ALL_KINDS += 'nerve' — with Header's ALL_KINDS.map this IS the Systems-row mechanism, and VIEW_PRESETS['brainstem-focus'].kinds === ALL_KINDS so the layer is on at boot, which store.ts:860 requires); scripts/validate-data.mjs (KINDS += 'nerve'; FROZEN SLUG_RE extended to ^(nuc|tract|vent|surf|vasc|ctx|nrv)-[a-z0-9-]+$ per PLAN.md §3 — chosen over reusing ctx- because prefix-follows-kind is the stated rule; a new executable PREFIX_KIND map now asserts prefix==kind for every registry row and every authored record that carries a kind, measured 0 violations over 248 rows; optional modality/course string checks; a per-KIND census line printing registry AND authored histograms); src/components/Header.tsx (KIND_LABELS += nerve: 'Cranial nerves'; comments corrected from 'six buttons'); src/components/Legend.tsx (palette swatch {label:'Cranial nerves', token:'var(--kind-nerve)'} beside 'Cranial-nerve nuclei', with a comment that the list is a plain array tsc cannot check); src/components/viewer3d/NucleusMesh.tsx (KIND_OPACITY.nerve = 1 and an explicit hintForKind('nerve') -> 'nucleus' branch; both now EXPORTED so the gate asserts shipped values); src/components/viewer3d/SceneLayers.tsx (documented that isSolidKind needs no entry for nerve and the exact schematic-placement path an nrv-* record takes — no behaviour change); NEW scripts/verify/nerve-kind.mjs (51,401 B, 79 assertions, 9 sections, exit 0). TWO OUT-OF-LIST EDITS, both required and both named in the plan of record: src/components/KindGlyph.tsx (KIND_GLYPH is an exhaustive Record<Kind,string>, so `npm run check` cannot exit 0 without a glyph — nerve: '✦') and src/styles/tokens.css (--kind-nerve: #14b8a6, without which the new Legend swatch would render with an undefined var). docs/ was NOT touched (integrator-owned): the same frozen regex is still stale at docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md:90, docs/CONTENT_INVENTORY.md:59, docs/ENGINEERING_PLAN.md:229 and docs/SWARM_V9_PLAN.md:40 — handoff listed below. GATE CONTENT (all executed, numbers printed): ALL_KINDS ≡ validator KINDS ≡ the Kind union ≡ KIND_GLYPH/KIND_OPACITY key sets (7 kinds, nerve last); SLUG contract accepts all 12 nrv-cn* ids and still rejects cn3-oculomotor / nrv-CN3 / nerve-cn3 / nrv-; the rendered Header (React's own renderToStaticMarkup) carries one Systems button per ALL_KINDS entry in order inside the 'Structure systems' group, all aria-pressed=true at boot, unique labels, visible text a prefix of the accessible name, nerve reading exactly 'Cranial nerves'; the rendered Legend has a swatch for every kind whose token resolves in tokens.css and one checkbox row per kind (nerve checked); toggling is driven by CALLING the real onClick from a live element tree (a minimal hook dispatcher whose useSyncExternalStore returns getSnapshot — React's server renderer cannot show a post-toggle state because zustand hands it api.getServerState || api.getInitialState, measured) and removes exactly 'nerve' from layers.kinds leaving regions/hidden/emphasis untouched, flips exactly that one aria-pressed, and round-trips byte-identically; a synthetic nrv-* probe is admitted by the SHIPPED SceneLayers.isStructureVisible iff the nerve kind is on (region gate still applies); geometry honesty (no nrv-* GLB, no anatomy-manifest part, no anatomyAssets LINK, every record meshes:false with a sized placement inside AXIS_BOUNDS); the store's load-time assertions re-run on two imports plus the audit-checks Node mirror EXECUTED as a child (stdio inherit — piped child stdio is EPERM here); and a BITE half where 8 defective kind tables (dropped kind in ALL_KINDS / validator / union, blank label, missing swatch, typo'd CSS token, missing glyph, missing opacity) are each caught by name. VERIFIED (final sweep on the current tree): validate exit 0 — 0 errors/0 warnings, 248 registry entries (0 awaiting), kinds registry nerve 12 (7 kinds), 19 structure files/225 records, authored nerve 12; check exit 0; build exit 0 (9.68s); verify:pipeline 138/138 parts · 599,204 tris · 386 loops · 0 problems; verify:plane 10,827 assertions; verify:plane-helper-extent 206/0; verify:somatotopy 45/0; verify:cortical-lobes 564/564; verify:pip-contract 187/0; verify:division-toggles 251/0; verify:view-filter-consistency 102/102 (grew from 100 with the 7th kind); verify:audit-checks 92/0; verify:closure-bite 7/7 mutations caught; verify:boundary-contract 22/0; verify:a11y-contract 38/0; verify:budget-report PASSED 599,204 tris · GLB 13.82 MiB · imaging 9.02 MiB; verify-imaging-v4 PASSED and -v4b exit 0; node scripts/verify/nerve-kind.mjs exit 0. CENSUS (printed by the gate, PLAN §7 evidence): kind=nerve -> 12 taxonomy rows, 12 authored records, 12 with meshes:false, 12 with origin3d+size3d inside AXIS_BOUNDS, 0 manifest parts, 0 GLBs, 0 anatomyAssets links, regions telencephalon 2 / midbrain 2 / pons 4 / medulla 4, all admitted at boot and all removed when the kind is toggled off while the other 167 admitted structures are unchanged. AREA-TOGGLES DELTA (measured, not blamed on this change, product NOT bent back): 225 passed/25 failed at base -> 27 failed now, i.e. the 25 pre-v12 header failures PLUS exactly 2 more of the same class, both hardcoded 6-element snapshots ('the boot systems row (aria-pressed per button) = [true x7] (expected [true x6])' and 'the rendered systems row boots fully pressed = ["true" x7] (expected ["true" x6])'); the third changed line is the same pre-existing Σ failure re-numbered (222/236 -> 234/248). PLAN §7's claim that 'the 25 pre-existing failures stay exactly 25' is wrong on these two — the review task re-points them. ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED, not claimed: verify:anatomy (exit 1, execFileSync('powershell') EPERM at anatomy-qa.mjs:294, 0 assertions) and verify:imaging-fit (exit 1, spawnSync node.exe EPERM) — both pre-existing; NOTE for that lane: the sandbox denies PIPED child stdio, but spawnSync with stdio:'inherit' works (this gate runs the audit-checks mirror that way, exit 0), so an anatomy lane that does not need the child's stdout can execute here. build-anatomy-geometry.mjs --manifest (README tier 1) was NOT run against src/ (its --manifest mode writeFileSync's src/assets/anatomy/anatomy-manifest.json, outside this task's write scope); instead it was run in an isolated copy of the tree (assets-src junctioned): exit 0 in 163.7s, parts 138 (nucleus 86 · context 17 · ventricle 5 · vessel 30), triangles 599,204 / ≤800,000 PASS, GLB 13.82 MiB / ≤14 MiB PASS, and the rebuilt manifest is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the committed one (64,073 B) — no geometry, no GLB and no manifest part was added by this slice. NOT CLAIMED (orchestrator/browser lane): verify:audit, verify:acceptance, verify:browser — Chrome cannot start in the sandbox.
